newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurd rebels kill Turkish policeman and soldier.
newsitem.headline: Kurd rebels kill Turkish policeman and soldier.

text.p: Kurdistan Workers Party guerrillas killed a policeman and a soldier in an attack in southeast Turkey, police said on Monday.
They said the rebels opened fire on a public building in the town of Savur on Sunday night and then fled.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict between the armed forces and the guerrillas, fighting for Kurdish self-rule.
